 ORDER Heard Sri Nataraj D, advocate for petitioner and Sri Venkata Satyanarayan A, learned High Court Government Pleader.
2. The present petition under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure is filed with the following prayer:
"WHEREFORE, the petitioner most humbly prays that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to allow this petition and enlarge the petitioner on bail and release him from custody pertaining to Crime No.145/2022 of Kote Police Chitradurga for the offence punishable under Section 420, 465, 468 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code pending before the II Additional Senior Civil Judge, Chitradurga, in the interest of justice and equity."
3.

entities.text: II Additional Senior Civil Judge, Chitradurga
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This court, by a considered order dated 04.09.2023 in Criminal Petition No.3865/2023 granted bail to accused No.4.
The present petitioner is accused No.2 and is only an accountant who also processed the application of the applicant seeking compassionate appointment.

The role that has been assigned to the present petitioner and that of accused No.4 are practically similar and therefore, on the ground of parity, present petitioner has made out a case for grant of bail.

Hence, without discussing further on the merits of the matter, the following order is passed:
ORDER
( i) The Petition is allowed.

(ii) Petitioner/accused No.2 be directed to be enlarged on bail in of Crime No.145/2022 of Chitradurga Kote Police Station which is now pending in CC No.267/2023 on the file of II Additional Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Chitradurga,
by taking a bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees one lakh only) with two sureties for the likesum to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Judge.
